narration.edits: lead-in silence and two non-lexical hums removed; no words cut or time-stretched

shots.title: The mystery
shots.vo: Kabhi aasman mein aeroplane ke peeche ye lambi white line dekhi hai? Kya plane aasman mein dhuaan chhod raha hai? Ya phir kuch aur?
shots.visual: 3D air-to-air tracking shot at cruise; contrail forms ~1 aircraft length behind engines; push onto the trail at 'white line'

shots.title: Not every plane
shots.vo: Interesting baat ye hai ki ye line har aeroplane ke peeche nahi dikhti.
shots.visual: Ground-view telephoto: higher (colder) jet leaves a trail, lower jet does not

shots.title: Seconds vs hours
shots.vo: Kabhi ye kuch seconds mein gayab ho jaati hai… aur kabhi ghanton tak aasman mein bani rehti hai!
shots.onScreenText: DISAPPEARS IN SECONDS | PERSISTS FOR HOURS (TIME-LAPSE)
shots.visual: Vertical split: short-lived trail vs persistent spreading trail

shots.title: Name reveal
shots.vo: Actually, ise kehte hain Contrail — yaani Condensation Trail!
shots.visual: Kinetic typographic etymology over abstract trail

shots.title: Engine physics
shots.vo: Jab jet engine se nikli garam, water-vapour wali exhaust bahut thandi hawa se milti hai,
shots.visual: Cycles-rendered turbofan + Three.js particles in Blender's exported camera: invisible hot plume, entrained cold air, white trail forms after mixing

shots.title: Ice crystals
shots.vo: toh tiny ice crystals ban jaate hain. Aur wahi humein aasman mein white line ki tarah dikhte hain.
shots.onScreenText: VAPOUR → DROPLET → ICE / TINY ICE CRYSTALS (≈ µm) / WHITE LINE = billions of tiny ice crystals
shots.visual: Macro: vapour condenses on soot nuclei, droplets freeze into hexagonal plates; pull back into the sky trail

shots.title: Twist
shots.vo: Lekin twist ye hai — contrail kitni der rahegi,

shots.title: Upper atmosphere
shots.vo: ye mainly depend karta hai upper atmosphere ki humidity par.
shots.visual: Altitude cross-section with cruise band and ice-relative humidity gauge

shots.title: Dry vs ice-supersaturated
shots.vo: Dry air mein jaldi gayab, aur humid air mein kaafi der tak reh sakti hai!
shots.onScreenText: DRY AIR (RHi<100%) | ICE-SUPERSATURATED (RHi>100%) / HUMIDITY CHANGES EVERYTHING
shots.visual: Split-screen, same flight in two atmospheres

shots.title: Climate challenge + CTA
shots.vo: Ab ek tricky question! Kya aeroplane ki white contrails Earth ke climate ko affect kar sakti hain? Answer comment mein batayein. A, B ya C comment karo aur Defence Pathshala ko follow karna mat bhoolna!
shots.onScreenText: TRICKY QUESTION! / A HAAN, CLIMATE PAR ASAR PADTA HAI · B NAHI, YE SIRF PAANI HAI · C SIRF BAARISH WALE DIN / COMMENT A, B YA C / FOLLOW DEFENCE PATHSHALA
